Shared key-value store base types, error codes, key helpers, and value metadata definitions.

# Purpose
This header defines the base types and helper functions for `vinyl`, a persistent shared key-value store that uses non-volatile storage. It declares the common error codes, the `fd_vinyl_key_t` key format, and inline helpers to initialize, compare, and hash keys. It also defines the `fd_vinyl_info_t` layout used to store decoded value size and application metadata, along with the maximum value size limit `FD_VINYL_VAL_MAX`. The file serves as the core ABI and utility layer for code that works with vinyl keys, values, and metadata.
